address: Al Amir Fawwaz Al Junoobi, Jeddah, 22431, Saudi Arabia
bio: A large cafe cum Hijazi-style restaurant located in a busy parade of shops away from the city centre. Its bright interior and even brighter team add to the delightful experience. The menu has something for everyone, from great flavoursome salads, fine beetroot tabbouleh, fresh kebabs – the chicken kebabs are noteworthy – and rich indulgent desserts. Be sure to have some Saudi coffee with dates at the start.
